figure1_digitization.axis_mapping: P=30*(pixel_x-48)/(367-48) GPa; V/V0=1-(pixel_y-67)*0.1/(194-67). Tabulated pressure is rounded to intended15,20,25GPa cross sections.
figure1_digitization.curve_selection: Visually identify black300K curve and successive red1000/1500/2000K curves; center pixel clusters at x208,261,314. Avoid data-symbol overlaps. Raw pixel coordinates retained.
figure1_digitization.tolerance: 0.002 in V/V0 allows roughly two raster pixels plus axis/cross-section rounding. Not a statistical uncertainty; neither higher precision nor unique theta-law discrimination is claimed.

uncertainties.new_lattice: 2011 paragraph4: standard deviation of average lattice parameter values; parenthetic last-digit widths split without changing them.
uncertainties.new_pressure: Parenthetic widths preserved; statistical confidence convention unspecified. Typical0.25-0.5GPa and200K systematic estimates are prose, not per-row independent errors.
uncertainties.new_temperature: Upstream/downstream readings remain separate. FigureS1 independently confirms the rounded arithmetic mean for all9 cycle2 measurements, including2515K. The same first-cycle averaging remains an inference. NaCl midpoint formula follows primary prose. No rowwise T SD/covariance invented.
uncertainties.liu: No rowwise errors printed in Table1; missing remains missing.
uncertainties.suzuki: 95% confidence of fitted solution; not measurement error bars. Extrapolated rows retain flags.
uncertainties.finger: Table2 estimated standard deviations of least quoted units.

fit_assessment.source_equation_validation: Primary-citation-supported constant-q reconstruction: DD2007 Eqs14-17 and same-author dissertation Os Eqs1-5 independently support integrated theta and300K subtraction; direct ringwoodite equation/code declaration still missing.
fit_assessment.conditional_coefficient_agreement: Recovered subset sensitivity tests only, with fixed202GPa/4/685K/q2/n7/300K. Calculated Suzuki entries are never relabeled measurements.
fit_assessment.exact_author_workflow: Not reproduced: full input tables, mask, normalization, objective/weights, fitting order, numerical settings and covariance remain missing. Cycle2 mean sample temperatures are independently confirmed by9 primaryFigureS1 labels.
fit_assessment.static_1979: Primary source explicitly BM2, K0=196(6)GPa/Kprime4. Reconstruct with measured558.7(2)A3 fixed ambient cell and23C reference. Two compressed states agree within combined reported coordinate errors. Conditional two-row K0=196.2176GPa; no original objective/intercept/covariance recovery claim.
fit_assessment.published_residual_validation: Two independent digitized dissertationFigure9 hot-row residuals agree within0.10GPa. Author explicitly acknowledges the hot-data trend. Original combined fit remains unreproduced.

upstream_suzuki_1979_table1_fe_solution_.uncertainty_scope: Table1 printed +/- widths; no confidence convention inferred. Table2 halfwidths explicitly95% confidence of fitted solution.
upstream_suzuki_1979_table1_fe_solution_.use: Upstream model metadata only; never substituted into the2011 preferred EOS.

upstream_stixrude_2005.convention: Printed error widths retained; confidence level not established. Italic entries are systematics. No2005 parameter/error replaces2011 fitted/fixed constraints.

figure9_digitization.method: Two isolated hot triangle centers from horizontal error-bar intersections, matched to original TableS1 by pressure/temperature. 0.10GPa tolerance includes graphical/rounding mismatch, not an original measurement uncertainty. Never included in regressions.

brown_calibration_replay.conclusion: Midpoint-temperature Brown pressure replay improves residual RMS0.9831 to0.7477GPa(TableII) but hot residuals remain-1.9401/-1.0868GPa. DirectTableI gives-2.0493/-1.1981GPa. Original reduction is not reproduced.
brown_calibration_replay.table_disagreement: TableI+normalizedDebye differs fromTableII by about0.12GPa locally. New diagnostics identify an E_ZP/3 signature (RMS0.01097GPa over571cells); exact historical cause remains unresolved. No source table repair.
brown_calibration_replay.temperature_diagnostic: HalfT hypothesis evaluated against13 explicit alternatives; it fits closely but extra300K thermal-energy subtraction is comparably close. See brown_hypotheses_followup. No source pressure corrected.
brown_calibration_replay.uncertainty: Lattice-only SD propagated by dP/da. No rowwiseT error, full pressure error or covariance reconstruction.

brown_hypotheses_followup.objective: Unweighted pressure differences, GPa;14 accepted TableS1 rows or571 calculatedBrown cells. Fits diagnose reductions, not a new physical EOS or historical author fit.
brown_hypotheses_followup.nacl_temperature_inference: Tsample/2 atn2 givesRMS0.10548GPa versus stated midpoint0.45597. ExtraE300 subtraction gives0.11379; half-temperature is supported but not uniquely established.
brown_hypotheses_followup.wrong_n_test: Brown within-volume temperature slopes implyn2.0007386. Wrongn alone cannot explain an almost temperature-independent offset. Correctperformula n2 is equivalent to cellbasis n8 with4times the molar volume.
brown_hypotheses_followup.brown_offset_signature: Adding E_ZP/3, withE_ZP=9nRtheta/8, givesRMS0.01097GPa over571 cells. Equivalent to changing DebyeD3 linear coefficient-3/8 to-1/4. Jointfit n1.999366, fraction0.337725. Signature only: no historical code or physical correction established.
brown_hypotheses_followup.ringwoodite_n_test: All9 digitized published thermal-curve checkpoints agree at n7 with fixed source coefficients. None agree atn1,2,4 within0.002V/V0. Curves remain calculated graphical checks, not measurements.
